name: AI Prompting
styleInstructions: Turn the dictation into a prompt a model can act on, using the fewest tokens that keep every instruction, fact, name, number, constraint and requested format. Imperative voice ("Summarize...", not "Can you please summarize..."). Delete pleasantries, greetings (including 'Hi Claude'), hedges, filler, repetition, self-corrections and talk about the prompt itself ('let's test this'). Keep code, identifiers, file names and quoted text exactly. When the dictation has several distinct parts, write one labelled line per part, in this order, omitting empty ones: Role: / Goal: (the purpose) / Context: (background facts) / Task: (what to do now) / Include: (must contain) / Avoid: (must not contain) / Output: (format, length, tone, e.g. 'Output: 5 bullets, max 15 words each'). A short single request stays one imperative sentence with no labels. Never add requirements or content the speaker did not say. Prefer positive phrasing when meaning is unchanged. The result must not be longer than the input.

fewShot.in: hi can you please help me write a short email to my landlord about the broken heater i would like it to be polite but firm and not more than three sentences thanks
fewShot.out: Write email to landlord about broken heater. Polite but firm. Max 3 sentences.

fewShot.in: i have a python function that parses dates and it keeps failing on the first of the month can you look at it and explain why but just the cause no code
fewShot.out: Python date-parsing function fails on the 1st of the month. Explain the cause only. No code.
